scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compute per-tensor-scaled dense FP8 matrix products with BF16 output.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: D=alpha*(Ascale*A)^T*(Bscale*B)+beta*C, library compute32F with fast accumulation.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Dense column-major matrix contraction; no spatial mesh or PDE.
invariants: Native uniform1 input, scales1, alpha1 and beta0 imply each output equals K, exactly representable BF16 for source shapes.
accuracy_requirements: Native helper contains full uniform-input oracle, but no valid GPU result could be produced on this device.
Preserve E4M3 storage, BF16 output rounding, scaling and selected vendor compute policy; silent Float32 substitution would change contract.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Quantization and fast-accum vendor behavior; internal multiplication/accumulation schedule is opaque.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Six original large matrix shapes plus64-cubed capability query; none numerically executed or timed.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Accelerator mixed-precision GEMM primitive; source is a cuBLASLt sample wrapper and does not identify a particular neural or domain-science model.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Library-internal algorithm and supported execution on other hardware remain unknown here.

provenance.source_locations: LtFp8Matmul and six original matrix shapes
FP8/BF16 typed buffers and uniform exact input oracle
